es: Dirigir un evento de voluntariado: repartir tareas, encargar material a terceros con have/get, resolver un imprevisto y valorar al grupo.

teaching.en: I will have the bags delivered to the beach by nine.
teaching.es: Haré que lleven las bolsas a la playa antes de las nueve.
teaching.explanationEs: have + objeto + participio: encargas que otra persona lo haga.
segments: I will have the bags delivered
teaching.audioText: I will have the bags delivered to the beach by nine.

teaching.en: We had the rubbish collected before lunch because Sara arranged a van.
teaching.es: Mandamos recoger la basura antes del almuerzo porque Sara organizó una furgoneta.
teaching.explanationEs: Had the rubbish collected: el resultado importa, no quién lo hace.
segments: We had the rubbish collected before
lunch because Sara arranged a van.
teaching.audioText: We had the rubbish collected before lunch because Sara arranged a van.

teaching.en: I will get Tom to deliver the gloves before nine.
teaching.es: Conseguiré que Tom entregue los guantes antes de las nueve.
teaching.explanationEs: get + persona + to + verbo base: convences u organizas a alguien.
teaching.audioText: I will get Tom to deliver the gloves before nine.

teaching.en: The forecast says rain, so let's move the stalls instead of cancelling the event.
teaching.es: El pronóstico dice lluvia, así que movamos los puestos en lugar de cancelar el evento.
teaching.explanationEs: Forecast = pronóstico; instead of + -ing propone la alternativa.
segments: The forecast says rain, so let's move
the stalls instead of cancelling the event.
teaching.audioText: The forecast says rain, so let's move the stalls instead of cancelling the event.

teaching.en: Could you arrange the tables near the shelter?
teaching.es: ¿Podrías organizar las mesas cerca del refugio?
teaching.explanationEs: Shelter = refugio; la petición cortés sigue sirviendo para delegar.
teaching.audioText: Could you arrange the tables near the shelter?

teaching.en: At the end, I give feedback: the team worked well, and next time we can start earlier.
teaching.es: Al final doy mi valoración: el equipo trabajó bien y la próxima vez podemos empezar antes.
teaching.explanationEs: Feedback = valoración; combina elogio y una sugerencia.
segments: At the end, I give feedback: the team worked
well, and next time we can start earlier.
teaching.audioText: At the end, I give feedback: the team worked well, and next time we can start earlier.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase encarga la tarea a otra persona?

choices.text: I'll deliver the bags by ten.
I'll have the bags delivered by ten.
I'll be delivering the bags by ten.

feedback.es: Have + objeto + participio significa que otra persona hace la tarea; las otras dos dicen que la haces tú.

hint.es: Busca la estructura have + cosa + participio.

prompt.es: Completa: «Conseguiré que Tom traiga los guantes.»

feedback.es: Con get + persona, el verbo va con to y en forma base.

hint.es: Después de get + persona va esta palabra y el verbo base.

origin.text: I'll get Tom ___ bring the gloves.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Mandaremos recoger la basura antes del almuerzo.»

answer.text: We will have the rubbish collected before lunch

feedback.es: Have + objeto + participio (collected) dice que la basura la recoge otra persona.

hint.es: Después de have va el objeto y luego el participio.

prompt.es: ¿Cuál es la mejor solución para el imprevisto?

choices.text: Let's stop the event and go home.
Let's leave the stalls on the open beach.
Let's move the stalls under the shelter instead of cancelling.

feedback.es: Una buena solución mantiene el evento y resuelve la lluvia. Las otras o cancelan o ignoran el problema.

origin.text: The forecast says heavy rain at noon, and the stalls are on the open beach.

prompt.es: Escucha a Carlos y elige quién traerá los guantes.

choices.text: His brother will bring them.
Carlos will bring them on his own.
The council will bring them.

feedback.es: Carlos no puede llevarlos él mismo y consigue que su hermano los traiga con «get my brother to bring them».

origin.audio: I can't carry the gloves myself. I'll get my brother to bring them in his van at nine.

prompt.es: Completa las dos frases con el participio adecuado.

feedback.es: Con have o get + objeto va el participio del verbo que hace otra persona: moved y collected.

sentences: We had the tables ___ to the shelter.
The council will get the rubbish ___ at two.

choices.text: She is easy-going and hard-working.
She is level-headed and open-minded.
She is decisive and reliable.

feedback.es: Mantiene la calma y pide ideas a todos: level-headed y open-minded. Las otras parejas no encajan con sus acciones.

origin.text: When the bags did not arrive, Sara stayed calm, asked everybody for ideas and made a new plan.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué hará la líder con los guantes.

choices.text: She will bring them to Mia herself.
She will ask Tom to check them.
Somebody else will deliver them to Mia by nine.

feedback.es: «I'll have the gloves delivered» indica que otra persona los lleva; la líder no los trae ella misma y Mia solo debe revisarlos cuando lleguen.

origin.audio: Tom, would you be willing to bring the bags? And Mia, I'll have the gloves delivered to you by nine, so please check them.

prompt.es: Completa: «Mandamos arreglar la carpa antes del evento.»

feedback.es: Con have + objeto, el verbo va en participio: repaired (o fixed), porque otra persona arregla la carpa.

origin.text: We had the tent ___ before the event.

prompt.es: Escribe un mensaje de 70–100 palabras dirigiendo la limpieza de la playa.

answer.text: Good morning, team, and thank you for coming. Mia, could you check the gloves before nine? Tom, I'd appreciate it if you could bring the bags in your van. Sara, would you be willing to put up the signs? I will have the shop deliver more bags by ten. The forecast says rain at noon, so let's move the stalls under the shelter instead of cancelling. You are doing a great job! One thing we could improve: next time, let's start earlier.
accepted: Good morning, team, and thank you for coming. Mia, could you check the gloves before nine? Tom, I'd appreciate it if you could bring the bags in your van. Sara, would you be willing to put up the signs? I will have the shop deliver more bags by ten. The forecast says rain at noon, so let's move the stalls under the shelter instead of cancelling. You are doing a great job! One thing we could improve: next time, let's start earlier.

Hello, everybody. Thank you for your help today. Mia, could you check the gloves by nine? Tom, it'd be great if you could bring the bags in your van. Sara, I'd appreciate it if you could put up the signs. I will have more bags delivered by ten. The forecast says rain at noon, so we will move the stalls to the shelter instead of stopping. You did great work. Next time, let's start earlier, please.

feedback.es: Un buen cierre de evento reparte tareas con tacto, encarga el material con have o get, resuelve la lluvia y valora al grupo con un comentario constructivo.

origin.text: Caso: limpieza de la playa, sábado. Tareas: Mia, los guantes antes de las nueve; Tom, las bolsas en su furgoneta; Sara, los carteles. Material: encarga a la tienda que entregue más bolsas antes de las diez. Imprevisto: lluvia a las doce; mueve los puestos al refugio. Valoración final: agradece y añade un comentario constructivo.

evidenceGroups: Mia, I'd appreciate it if you could
Mia, it'd be great if you could
Tom, I'd appreciate it if you could
Tom, it'd be great if you could

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase mezcla agradecimiento y crítica constructiva?

choices.text: Thanks for your help. Next time, let's start earlier.
Thanks for your help, but you were late.
You were late, so no thanks.

feedback.es: Agradece primero y propone una mejora concreta con next time. Las otras solo reprochan el retraso.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué hará el grupo mientras espera.

choices.text: They will go home.
They will sort the bags by hand.
They will repair the van.

feedback.es: El grupo no cancela ni arregla la furgoneta: mientras tanto clasifica las bolsas a mano, y el conductor vuelve a mediodía.

origin.audio: The van is broken. Let's get the driver to come back at noon, and meanwhile we will sort the bags by hand.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Te agradecería que pudieras traer los guantes.»

answer.text: I'd appreciate it if you could bring the gloves

feedback.es: La fórmula cortés de delegar I'd appreciate it if you could sigue siendo útil al dirigir un evento.
